source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
STG.[PRODUCT_CODE]
,[PRODUCT_NAME]
,[PRODUCT_DESC]
,[INV_TYPE]
,[MIN_HOLD_PERIOD]
,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([MIN_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) as MIN_AMT
,[MIN_CURRENCY]
,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([MAX_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) as MAX_AMT
,[MAX_CURRENCY]
,[AUM_NOM]
,[DOCS_REQD]
,[REMARKS]
,[PROD_CLASS]
,[STATUS]
,[AUTH_ID]
,convert(date,[AUTH_DATE]) as AUTH_DATE
,[MAKER_ID]
,convert(date,[MAKER_DATE]) as MAKER_DATE
,[REJECT_REASON]
,[BR_CD]
,convert(numeric(25,5),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([RESERVE_PER],' ',''),''),0)) as RESERVE_PER
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[TRU_TRUPRODUCTS_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [D360].[STG_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS] STG ON DELTA.PRODUCT_CODE = STG.PRODUCT_CODE 
 where H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
STG.[SUBSCRIPTION_ID]
,[BR_CD]
,STG.[BASE_NO]
,[LAST6_BASE_NO]
,[SUBSCRIPTION_NAME]
,[PRODUCT_ID]
,[PURPOSE]
,convert(date,[INCEPTION_DATE]) as INCEPTION_DATE
,[MARKETING_OFFICER]
,STG.[STATUS]
,[PAYMENT_TYPE]
,[RC_DIVISION]
,[REFERRED_BY]
,convert(date,[REVIEW_DATE]) as REVIEW_DATE
,[DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION]
,[TBG_REFERRAL]
,[FEE_SERVICE]
,[MAKER_ID]
,convert(date,[MAKER_DATE]) as MAKER_DATE
,[AUTH_ID]
,convert(date,[AUTH_DATE]) as AUTH_DATE
,[REJECT_REASON]
,[TRUST_AGMT_EXT]
,[TRUST_AGMT_INT]
,[MANDATE]
,[IS_BLACKLISTED]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,convert(date,[BLACKLISTED_DATE]) AS BLACKLISTED_DATE
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [D360].[STG_TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION] STG ON DELTA.BASE_NO = STG.BASE_NO AND DELTA.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = STG.SUBSCRIPTION_ID 
 where H = 'D'

SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_TRU_BASELINK WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_TRU_AUMNONUITF WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
STG.[BASE_NO]
,[LAST6_BASE_NO]
,STG.[PF_NO]
,[LAST6_PF_NO]
,[PROD_CODE] as PRODUCT_CODE
,convert(numeric(22,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([AUM],' ',''),''),0)) as AUM
,convert(numeric(22,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([AUM_IN_PHP],' ',''),''),0)) as AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR
,convert(date,STG.[ASOFDATE]) as ASOFDATE
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[TRU_AUMNONUITF_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [D360].[STG_TRU_AUMNONUITF] STG ON DELTA.BASE_NO = STG.BASE_NO AND DELTA.PF_NO = STG.PF_NO AND DELTA.ASOFDATE = STG.ASOFDATE
 where H = 'D'
